Each card shows the hourly yacht rate and minimum duration. Use those figures for an initial budget, then ask for a quote for your date covering inclusions, optional arrangements and any taxes or fees. Availability is checked when you enquire.

Yacht comparison questions
How do I choose the right capacity?

Count everyone in your group, including children, and choose a yacht whose maximum capacity covers that number. Discuss seating, dining and access needs with the team too.

How do I estimate the rental cost?

Multiply the hourly rate by the number of hours you want, allowing for the yacht's minimum duration. Ask for a full quote for your date and any extras.

What if I need a particular facility?

Check the yacht photos and specifications, then ask the team about the facility you need. Bedroom counts are shown where available; the team can help with layout and equipment questions.

Can I check availability before choosing?

Yes. Send your preferred date, start time, duration, guest count and budget. The team can help you compare options for your request.

Website and Yacht Request Terms

Effective date: 14 July 2026

1. Scope, public brand and responsible parties

Dubai Yacht is the public brand of an online private-yacht comparison and request-planning service operated by Mohammed Abdullah, Operation Manager. These terms govern use of the Dubai Yacht website and the preparation of private-yacht enquiries. The specific written confirmation identifies the yacht or service provider and the responsible contracting party for the requested service. Website content is informational. Viewing a page, preparing an enquiry, sending a WhatsApp message or making a phone call does not itself form or confirm a booking.

2. Enquiries and written confirmation

A booking becomes confirmed only through an explicit written confirmation that identifies the selected yacht, date, start time, duration, guest count, price and any approved optional items. A request is subject to availability until that confirmation is issued.

3. Published information and prices

Published yacht facts, hourly prices and minimum durations support planning. The final written confirmation controls booking-specific availability, price and agreed details. It does not exclude mandatory consumer rights or excuse inaccurate or misleading website information.

4. Payments, changes and cancellation terms

The website does not process payments. Any payment method, deposit, balance, cancellation, refund or rescheduling rules will be supplied in the specific written offer or confirmation. This website does not set one universal policy for those matters.

5. Capacity and guest information

The published maximum capacity for the selected yacht must not be exceeded. The requester should provide an accurate guest count and any information needed for the yacht-specific written confirmation.

6. Departure, weather and operations

Departure location and route vary by yacht and confirmed booking. Weather, safety or operational conditions may require a change, delay or cancellation. Any applicable outcome will be addressed under the specific written offer or confirmation; this website does not promise a particular outcome.

7. Safety and conduct

Guests must follow the confirmed yacht’s safety and conduct instructions and the directions of the responsible operator or crew. Yacht-specific requirements concerning identification, children, arrival time and prohibited conduct should be confirmed before the booking.

8. Optional items and third-party providers

Catering, decorations, entertainment, photography, activities and other optional items are subject to availability, supplier confirmation, separate pricing and the final written confirmation. Third-party providers may apply their own terms. Any material third-party terms that apply to an optional item should be disclosed or made available before that item is confirmed.

9. Website availability and liability

The website may be updated or become temporarily unavailable. No insurance coverage, limitation of liability or guaranteed remedy applies unless it is expressly identified in the specific written confirmation. Nothing in these terms excludes or limits any right or liability that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited.

10. Governing law and disputes

These website and request terms are governed by the laws of the United Arab Emirates as applicable in Dubai. Subject to any mandatory applicable law, disputes are submitted to the courts of Dubai.

11. Contact

Questions about these terms may be raised through WhatsApp or by calling +971 50 464 1020. This contact channel does not by itself confirm a booking or accept a requested change.

Mohammed Abdullah, Operation Manager is the responsible business recipient and controller for the enquiry information described in this notice. This notice explains how information is handled when you use the website or choose to contact Mohammed Abdullah, Operation Manager through WhatsApp or phone.

The website form prepares a message locally in your browser. It does not submit the form values to this website, Netlify, email, a form-submission database or an internal API. Website-generated form values are not retained by the website after the browser session.

If you choose WhatsApp, you decide to send the prepared information to WhatsApp/Meta and Mohammed Abdullah, Operation Manager. If you call, your device and telephone-network provider process the call. Mohammed Abdullah, Operation Manager may then receive the information you choose to communicate.

5. Hosting and production media

Netlify may process technical request, diagnostic and security logs while hosting the website. Approved production image hosts receive ordinary technical requests, which may include an IP address, browser or device information, requested resource or page, timestamp and security-log information, to deliver images and protect their services.

6. Purposes and processing basis

Information may be used to respond, prepare availability or pricing, administer a confirmed service, prevent misuse, protect legal rights and meet applicable obligations. Information is processed only where permitted by applicable law, including to take steps requested by you before a possible booking, administer a confirmed service, comply with legal obligations, protect legal rights or where you have provided valid consent.

7. Providers and international processing

Information may be processed by WhatsApp/Meta, the applicable telephone-network provider, Netlify, approved production image hosts, yacht providers and approved optional-service providers, as relevant to your use of the website or request. Information is shared with yacht or optional-service providers only as needed to answer or fulfil your request. Some processing may occur outside the UAE. Cross-border processing remains subject to applicable legal requirements and relevant provider arrangements.

8. Retention

Website-generated form values are not stored by the website after the browser session. WhatsApp and phone communications are retained while an enquiry is active and afterwards only as needed to administer a confirmed booking, address questions or disputes, and meet applicable business, accounting or legal obligations. Information should be deleted or anonymised when it is no longer required for those purposes.

9. Privacy rights and requests

Subject to applicable law, you may request:

Correction of inaccurate information
Deletion of information
Restriction or cessation of processing
Transfer or portability where applicable
Withdrawal of consent where processing relies on consent
A complaint to the competent UAE authority

Privacy requests may be made through the approved WhatsApp number associated with +971 50 464 1020. Requests are handled subject to applicable law. Identity or request details may need to be confirmed before action is taken.

Analytics and advertising tracking are disabled in this release. The website does not use GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, advertising tags, conversion events, consent mode, analytics cookies or advertising cookies. The website application does not set other browser cookies or local storage in this release. Netlify, WhatsApp/Meta, telephone-network providers and approved production image hosts may use essential technical or provider-set technologies when their services are requested, under their own policies.

11. Security

Reasonable technical and organisational measures are used to protect information, but no internet transmission or storage method can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

The service is not intended for children to submit enquiries independently. A parent or guardian should make an enquiry concerning a child or a group that includes children.
